title: The Echo Self
text: Each Scion meets themselves coming back the other way along the path, older and thinner, carrying scars they do not have yet. The echoes look tired and sorry. Each seems to have something it wants to say.

options.label: Each Scion speaks with their older self, hoping to learn what is to come.

outcomes.text: The echo gives advice, from one who knows how it goes. They take it to heart.
The echo gives a warning they did not want. It comes true in the telling.

options.label: Each Scion walks past their echo without a word. Some futures are better not heard.

outcomes.text: The echo does not look back. It never did, and now they know they never will.
